summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Nightly' option in the Focus chip dropdown (Iron Rabbit). Verified menu ordering, all three toast/mutation branches (no schedule, configured but master OFF, already active), regression on Turn ON + 30m timer, and overnight-window math used by the existing isInFocusWindow. All 11 assertions PASSED. No new scheduling logic introduced; Nightly only flips settings.focus_schedule.enabled when a day is configured, otherwise informs the user.
critical_code_review_comments: FocusStatusChip.jsx: Nightly branch is clean, no new scheduling logic (as requested); uses spread copy `{ ...sched, enabled: true }` so per-day config is preserved.
Minor: pre-existing React hydration warning in console ('<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' inside category droppable) — unrelated to this task but worth fixing later.
Cosmetic: menu row order shows a divider between Nightly and 'Turn ON (indefinite)' which matches spec ('divider before Turn ON'). Correct.
seed_data_creation: Test seeded settings.focus_schedule directly into IndexedDB (IronRabbit → settings → app_settings) for Cases A/B/C and cleaned up at end. Also toggled focus_mode/focus_until back to defaults after regression checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chip has two elements sharing data-testid='focus-status-chip' historically (FocusStatusChip + GlobalFocusChip). Only FocusStatusChip is mounted on the main list surface — count came back as 1. Clicking the chip via `page.click('[data-testid=...]', force=True)` occasionally does NOT toggle the menu (event handler seems to need a real click). Use `page.get_by_role('button').filter(has_text='Focus · off').first.click()` instead. IndexedDB shape: name='IronRabbit', store='settings', key='app_settings'. Focus schedule shape: {enabled, recurring, days:{sun..sat:{enabled,start,end}}}. Sonner toasts render duplicated (visually stacked) — assert with `any(substr in t for t in toasts)`.

detailed_results.menu_order_correct: PASS — order: 30m, 1h, 2h, sunrise, nightly, [divider], manual, [divider], guide, guide-zip. Nightly sits between 'Until sunrise' and 'Turn ON (indefinite)' with a divider before the manual option (matches spec).
detailed_results.case_A_toast_shown: PASS — 'Configure a nightly schedule first' with description pointing to Settings → Focus Mode → Schedule Focus Mode.
detailed_results.case_A_no_mutation: PASS — settings.focus_schedule remained absent after Nightly tap.
detailed_results.case_B_days_unchanged: PASS — per-day enabled/start/end deeply equal to input config after Nightly tap.
detailed_results.case_D_overnight_math: PASS — start=22:00 end=06:30 → active at 23:30, active at 05:00, inactive at 12:00. Confirms overnight handling used by isInFocusWindow.
